traceability.notes: All aspects of 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are implemented and verified. Every relevant rule (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, valid-req-reference) defines clear meta.messages with the documented placeholders (e.g., {{functionName}}, {{missing}}, {{details}}, {{path}}, {{reqId}}, {{storyPath}}). Error messages are specific, actionable, and include contextual data (function name, file path, requirement ID). The require-story-annotation rule also provides ESLint suggestions with concrete remediation text, and tests assert the suggestion description and fix function. File- and requirement-reference rules distinguish between missing resources, invalid paths/extensions, and filesystem errors, and they surface each via distinct diagnostics with appropriate context, satisfying both REQ-ERROR-HANDLING and REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT. Multiple Jest test suites explicitly reference this story and its REQ-ERROR-* requirements, asserting messageIds and data payloads to enforce consistent wording and behavior across rules. Given the presence of dedicated tests tied to this story and their successful execution, all acceptance criteria and requirements for 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are met, so the story is assessed as PASSED.
